title: Fix keyboard layouts in KDE with Fcitx
summary: Resolve issues where KDE keyboard layouts do not switch correctly when Fcitx is running by disabling KDE's own layout configuration.

steps.explain: Stop Fcitx if it is running.

steps.gui: Open 'System Settings' from the application launcher.

steps.explain: Go to Input Devices > Layouts and uncheck 'Configure layouts'.
steps.gui: Navigate to 'Input Devices' > 'Layouts' tab. Uncheck the box 'Configure layouts'.

steps.explain: Go to Input Devices > Advanced and uncheck 'Configure keyboard options'.
steps.gui: Navigate to 'Input Devices' > 'Advanced' tab. Uncheck the box 'Configure keyboard options'.

steps.explain: Configure your layouts in Fcitx via the tray icon.
steps.gui: Right-click the Fcitx tray icon, select 'Configure', and add your desired layouts.

rollback.explain: Re-enable 'Configure layouts' and 'Configure keyboard options' in KDE System Settings.
rollback.gui: Go back to System Settings > Input Devices and re-check the boxes.

warnings: Disabling KDE layout configuration means you must manage all keyboard layouts through Fcitx.
